children.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems

detail.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Establishing a formal project to investigate hidden axiomatic structures as per research charter.

detail.title: Epistemological Falsification in Autonomous Agents
detail.question: Can an autonomous agent perform self-reflection to identify and challenge its foundational axioms, using principles of epistemological falsification?
detail.reason: The mission requires investigating whether durable state and rules allow for meaningful autonomous self-reflection.
